entities.name: PMID:25072612
observations: Fernández-Rodríguez et al. (2014) studied PPARγ2 rs1801282 and SVR in HIV/HCV-coinfected patients treated with pegylated interferon-α plus ribavirin.

entities.name: PPARG Pro12Ala and SVR
observations: In a retrospective cohort of 285 treatment-naive HIV/HCV-coinfected patients, rs1801282 CG/GG (Ala-carrier) genotypes were associated with higher SVR odds under a dominant model (adjusted OR 2.93, 95% CI 1.27–6.72; P=0.011) during pegylated interferon-α plus ribavirin therapy.
